title: Beyond Trajectory Statistics: Community-Consistent Human Mobility Generation via Evolving User-Location Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2610.28467v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Human mobility data are fundamental to Web-based location services and broader urban applications, and mobility generation provides synthetic trajectories when real data are costly or inaccessible. Although recent mobility generators have incorporated collective mobility patterns, they primarily focus on individual trajectories and aggregate population dynamics, leaving evolving community structures formed by user-location interactions insufficiently modeled. In this paper, we study community-consistent human mobility generation. To this end, we formulate mobility generation as the generation of dynamic user-location graphs to model community structures and propose MOTION, a Multi-agent framework for cOmmuniTy-consIstent human mObility geNeration. translated_title: 超越轨迹统计：通过演化的用户-位置图实现社区一致性的人类移动性生成
translated_abstract: 人类移动性数据是基于Web的位置服务以及更广泛城市应用的基础，而移动性生成技术则可以在真实数据成本高昂或难以获取的情况下提供合成轨迹。尽管近期的移动性生成器已经融入了集体移动模式，但它们主要关注个体轨迹和总体人群动态，对由用户-位置交互形成的不断演化的社区结构建模不足。在本文中，我们研究了社区一致性的人类移动性生成问题。为此，我们将移动性生成形式化为动态用户-位置图的生成，以对社区结构进行建模，并提出了MOTION，一个面向社区一致性人类移动性生成的多智能体框架。MOTION由用户智能体、位置智能体和全局管理器智能体组成。MOTION首先使用Leiden算法从历史移动数据中检测出连贯的社区，并提取社区...
tldr: 提出MOTION多智能体框架，将人类移动性生成形式化为动态用户-位置图的生成，从而建模并生成具有社区一致性的移动模式。
en_tdlr: Proposes MOTION, a multi-agent framework that formulates human mobility generation as dynamic user-location graph generation to model and produce community-consistent mobility patterns.
